run_flow_matching_training: run the flow matching model training on imagenet or cifar10 datasets with distributed data parallel support
run_training_with_args: run the training script with argparse cli to configure batch size learning rate and epochs
run_eval_only_mode: run the model in eval only mode to compute fid samples without training
run_distributed_training: run distributed multi gpu training with gradient accumulation and effective batch size calculation
run_checkpoint_resume: run training resuming from a saved checkpoint with optimizer and lr schedule state
